Generated Narrative: CodeSystem ie-core-v2-0203

This case-insensitive code system http://iehr.ai/fhir/ie/core/CodeSystem/ie-core-v2-0203 defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
IMC Irish Health Practitioner Regulation Agency Registration NumberAn Irish Medical Council (Imc) registration number assigned to a practitioner for each profession in which they are registered. Practitioners registered in more than one profession have one registration number for each profession.
EIRCODE EircodeDepartment of the Environment, Climate and Communications Eircode associated with a place.
CRN Company Registration NumberCompany Registration Number (CRN) assigned by Companies Registration Office Ireland (CRO) to a registered company.
HPI Health Service Provider IdentifierHealth Service Provider Identifier (HPI) assigned by HSE.
GMS General Medical ServiceMedical Card/GP Visit Cards - General Medical Service (GMS) in an Irish context.
DPS Drugs Payment SchemeDrugs Payment Scheme (DPS) in an Irish context.
HAA Health Amendment ActHealth Amendment Act (HAA) in an Irish context.
LTI Long Term IllnessLong Term Illness (LTI) in an Irish context.
